surface.basis: Pirelli 2025 Monaco GP preview: asphalt grip 2/5, asphalt abrasion 1/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 5, braking 2, lateral 1, tyre stress 1, track evolution 5, downforce 5.

source.notes: Projected to local metres, rotated to start on Boulevard Albert 1er, 8-15.5 m wide by section from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), walled at the kerb, scaled to the FIA 3,337 m. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along mc-1929 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m, scaled to the published 42.0 m highest to lowest.
